label: Small Biotech IND — IB Change Summary
description: Investigator's Brochure edition 3 change summary for NovaTide-1 (new safety + efficacy data).

inputs.previous_change_desc: Added Phase 1 dose-escalation preliminary PK data
inputs.current_change_desc: Updated safety data from Phase 1 expansion cohort; added preliminary efficacy signals
inputs.change_desc_1: Added adverse event data from 45 additional patients in dose-expansion cohort including 2 cases of Grade 3 cytokine release syndrome (CRS)
inputs.change_desc_2: Preliminary ORR of 52% (23/44 evaluable) at recommended Phase 2 dose, including 6 complete responses
inputs.change_desc_3: Population PK model updated with data from 60 patients; confirmed linear PK in therapeutic range
inputs.new_safety_data: The expanded safety database now includes 73 patients. Two new cases of Grade 3 CRS were managed with tocilizumab per protocol. No treatment-related deaths. The CRS mitigation algorithm (step-up dosing) reduced Grade ≥2 CRS from 22% to 8% in the step-up cohort.
inputs.updated_efficacy: Among 44 evaluable patients, ORR was 52% (CR 14%, PR 39%). Median duration of response not yet reached at median follow-up of 4.2 months. Responses observed across all dose levels ≥ 1 mg/kg.
inputs.revised_dosing: Recommended Phase 2 dose confirmed at 3 mg/kg IV weekly × 8, then q2w. Step-up dosing schedule added: 0.5 mg/kg (C1D1), 1.5 mg/kg (C1D8), 3 mg/kg (C1D15 onwards).
inputs.impact_assessment: do not alter the overall risk profile of NovaTide-1; the step-up dosing schedule significantly reduces CRS incidence and severity
inputs.prepared_by: Dr. Sarah Chen, VP Regulatory Affairs
